newsitem.title: POLAND: LOT passenger traffic up in 1996 Q1-Q3.
newsitem.headline: LOT passenger traffic up in 1996 Q1-Q3.

text.p: The number of passengers using Poland's national air carrier PLL LOT SA rose 10.7 percent to 1,564,000 people in the first nine months of 1996 against the same period last year, LOT said in a statement on Monday.
The number of passengers using foreign flights amounted to 1,325,000 and 239,000 passengers used domestic flights.
In 1996 LOT expects to carry a total of 2.1 million passengers on both domestic and foreign flights.
LOT said its passenger capacity was filled in 69.6 percent and was flat against last year's 69.3 percent.
LOT is slated for a partial sell-off late this year or early in 1997.
